title: Probes locais isolados da base poliglota da Workbench

local_isolated_probes.name: typescript-semantic-map-syntax-and-fixtures
local_isolated_probes.execution: Node --check + Node test runner against an isolated local copy of the current analyzer and equivalent fixtures
coverage: TypeScript diagnostics for intentionally missing import
local_isolated_probes.limitation: Not the repository's full CI workflow and not a full scan of the repository TS/TSX tree.

local_isolated_probes.name: workbench-executor-helper-probes
coverage: common API key, quoted password and Bearer redaction
rejection of explicitly secret-named child environment variables
POSIX process-group cancellation prevents a child process from surviving
local_isolated_probes.execution: Isolated Python harness reproducing the current helper implementations.
local_isolated_probes.limitation: Not the complete Workbench unittest suite; not a security sandbox test.

latest_ci_observation.classification: RUNNER_ALLOCATION_BLOCKED / NOT_RUN; this is not evidence of a code compilation failure.

acceptance_criteria: GitHub Workbench workflow receives a runner and starts steps.
All 23 Python Workbench test methods pass on the exact HEAD.
Both committed Node semantic-map tests pass on the exact HEAD.
TS typecheck, Vitest, ESLint and Vite build pass with bun.lock frozen.
Map is generated for the actual repository with zero TypeScript error diagnostics, or unresolved diagnostics are reviewed.
Security and process-control behavior is covered by the complete repository unit tests.
Kotlin semantic-analysis experiment remains separate; no Gradle/Android or Poco F6 validation is implied by these local probes.
note: This record inventories current implementations. Test counts are written-test counts only; no repository suite or Android capture is marked PASSED.

features: Requires app already foreground; never installs, launches or taps
Collects pre/post PSS, battery, thermal and display snapshots
Extracts sampled PNG frames via FFmpeg when installed
Calculates frame duration percentiles and optional explicit frame-budget overruns
limitations: No automatic UI state control or deterministic effect replay yet
Frame budget must be supplied for the expected refresh rate; the tool does not assume 60 or 120 Hz
Capture includes the full visible screen and requires private content/notifications to be closed

result_semantics.note: CAPTURED means all required capture artifacts were collected; it is not a performance or visual-quality pass.

animation_lab.artifact_integrity: SHA-256 recorded for MP4 and each extracted frame
animation_lab.preflight: Explicit serial, online/authorized ADB, booted device, installed package and foreground app are required before creating the run folder.
